title: Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT and the Black Hole Interior as a Holographic Code
abstract: The AdS/CFT correspondence implies bulk quantum gravity is holographically encoded in the boundary CFT. Recent work demonstrates this encoding functions as a quantum error-correcting code: bulk operators reconstructed from boundary subregions via RT formula and entanglement wedge reconstruction. The black hole interior emerges as a subspace protected by this code.

pipeline: Define AdS_{d+1} / CFT_d correspondence with bulk geometry G and boundary state |ψ⟩
Apply QEC framework: bulk operator φ(x) reconstructed from boundary region A iff x ∈ entanglement wedge of A
Analyze black hole interior as code subspace
Compute holographic complexity via CV or CA conjectures
Relate complexity growth to quantum scrambling

key_metrics.entanglement_wedge: Bulk region reconstructable from boundary subregion A
key_metrics.code_distance: Minimum boundary weight of bulk logical operator
key_metrics.complexity: C_V or C_A — holographic complexity conjectures

results.qec_structure: Bulk-to-boundary map is a [[n,k,d]] quantum code; black hole interior = logical subspace
results.page_curve: Unitary Page curve recovered when including island contributions
results.complexity_growth: Complexity grows linearly until t ~ e^S, then saturates — consistent with Lloyd bound
results.scrambling: Information thrown into black hole is scrambled in t_* ~ β log(S); recovered via Hawking radiation after Page time

cloud9_integration.ac_relevance: Holographic complexity C_V/C_A may be analogous to A_c: both measure 'how much structure' is required. We propose testing whether A_c(halo) correlates with a gravitational complexity proxy.
cloud9_integration.snn_implementation: Quantum error correction can be simulated classically via stabilizer codes. A Lava SNN can decode surface code syndromes in real-time.

validation_plan.task: Simulate 5-qubit surface code in Python; train SNN decoder on syndrome patterns
validation_plan.expected: SNN decoder achieves > 99% logical fidelity at p < 0.01 physical error rate

cross_cluster_links.relation: Holographic tensor networks (MERA) share topological entanglement structure with persistent homology filtrations
Black hole interior complexity growth may exhibit spin-glass-like dynamics near scrambling time
Integrated information Φ in holographic codes may be bounded by RT entropy — consciousness as boundary phenomenon

risks_and_limitations: AdS/CFT rigorously proven only for specific cases (e.g., N=4 SYM)
Holographic complexity conjectures (CV, CA) are not proven
Quantum error correction in holography assumes large-N limit
Connection to A_c is speculative — no known gravitational dual for halo assembly
next_experiments: Implement 5-qubit surface code decoder in Lava SNN; benchmark against MWPM
Compute holographic complexity for BTZ black hole using CV conjecture
Explore whether MERA tensor network can be mapped to persistent homology filtration
